title: 12 women saved R72,000 together #Stokvel
text:
Twelve women (an illustration) each put in R500 a month for a year: R72,000, R6,000 each for Christmas. That's a stokvel, and more than 11 million South Africans belong to one, saving about R50 billion a year. But some stokvels go wrong every year. The difference comes down to three things: written rules, a bank account that needs more than one signature, and records everyone can see.

Full guide: "Stokvels Explained: How to Protect Your Stokvel Money (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
